d:
Watch Fauji Episode 10, the iconic 1989 TV serial that marked the television debut of Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan!
This drama series revolves around young commandos joining an army training school. Their journey through rigorous training, friendships, daily life, fun-filled pranks, and punishments is showcased through the various memorable characters of the serial.
Witness Shah Rukh Khan in his early acting days, as he made his television debut with Fauji and captured the audience's attention with his natural acting and charismatic screen presence.
